tools.name: show_home_inventory
tools.description: Use when someone wants a home or household inventory (for insurance, a move or a storage unit) from photos of their rooms, shelves or boxes, or from a description. You identify each item and estimate what it would cost to replace; this tool shows the list room by room with counts and totals, and off

tools.name: home_inventory_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone asks how to make a home inventory for insurance, or what to include. Returns a room-by-room checklist of what to photograph and write down, from state insurance departments' and the Insurance Information Institute's advice, with a free printable PDF.

tools.name: find_my_stuff
tools.description: Use when the person asks where something of theirs is ("where are my passports?", "which box has the HDMI cables?"). Searches their BoxTrack items and shows each match with its photo and the box and room it is in. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the f

tools.name: show_my_box
tools.description: Use when the person asks what is in one of their boxes, bins or rooms ("what's in the garage bins?"). Shows the box with photos of what is inside, its value and the boxes inside it. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: my_inventory_value
tools.description: Use when the person asks what their things are worth, for insurance or a claim, or how complete their home inventory is. Shows the total, room by room, the most valuable items and how many have photos. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: list_my_items
tools.description: Use when the person asks for their items marked fragile, or tagged to ship, sell, store, donate or toss, items already sold, or items missing a photo or a value. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: my_boxes
tools.description: Use when the person asks what boxes or rooms they have in BoxTrack, or wants an overview. Shows every top-level room or box with photos, counts and values. Only for the person's own BoxTrack account; the chat app asks them to connect it the first time.

tools.name: check_insurance_coverage
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much their belongings are worth, how much personal property (Coverage C) or renters insurance they need, or whether they are underinsured. Estimates what the things in their home would cost to replace, room by room, against their coverage, and flags valuables over a standar

tools.name: estimate_moving_cost
tools.description: Use when someone asks what a move will cost, or whether to hire movers or do it themselves. Gives a rough range for doing it yourself, hiring movers, and movers who pack too, side by side, with what goes into it.

tools.name: pick_moving_truck_size
tools.description: Use when someone asks what size moving or rental truck they need. Shows how full each truck size would be for their home or their own list of furniture and boxes.

tools.name: estimate_moving_weight
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much their household goods weigh for a move, or whether they will go over a PCS (military) weight allowance or a weight-based quote.

tools.name: tip_movers
tools.description: Use when someone asks how much to tip movers or a moving crew. Works out a tip per mover from the hours, the crew and how hard the job was.

tools.name: count_moving_boxes
tools.description: Use when someone asks how many moving boxes they need, or which sizes. Counts boxes by size and room, with tape and labels.

tools.name: pick_storage_unit_size
tools.description: Use when someone asks what size storage unit they need (5x5, 10x10, 10x20 and so on). Shows how full each common size would be.

tools.name: price_garage_sale_items
tools.description: Use when someone asks what to charge at a garage or yard sale, or how to price things to sell. Suggests a price for each thing from what it cost new and its condition, or typical prices by kind of thing.

tools.name: sort_for_downsizing
tools.description: Use when someone downsizing, decluttering or clearing a home asks whether to keep, sell, give to family, donate or toss things. Ask the questions you need, then sort each thing into a pile with the reason.

tools.name: moving_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone wants a checklist: moving (8 weeks out to moving day), change of address (who to tell), first night box (what to pack to open first), moving out (getting the deposit back), first apartment (what to buy), snowbird (closing up one home for the season), pcs_move (military PCS inventory

tools.name: inventory_template

tools.name: show_book_list
tools.description: Use when someone shares photos of their bookshelves or lists their books and wants a list of their library or what their books are worth. You read the spines (title and author, rough value new); this tool shows it shelf by shelf. Only list what you can read.
